summary.text: Brian Cohn is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 57B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Jeff Witte (R).
A consultant with a background in engineering and product development, he was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brian Cohn was born in Chicago, Illinois, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Rochester in 1980, a graduate degree from Rochester in 1982 and a graduate degree from the University of Minnesota in 1996.

His career experience includes working as a consultant, engineer, project manager and product manager, and he has been affiliated with Minnesota Masters Swimming, Lakeville Lions, the Project Management Institute and the Product Development and Management Association.
Witte defeated Cohn in the 2024 general election for District 57B, 52.3 percent to 47.6 percent.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Cohn said he and his wife have lived in Lakeville for 10 years and have four adult children and a granddaughter.
He said his priorities include investing in public education, expanding access to mental health and addiction care, reducing gun violence, addressing climate change and improving infrastructure.
